facts.why: Beth Hatten is Loretta's publisher in the film and on Wikipedia, not her publicist.

vibe.verdict: Cute invite with the sequins and Dash in the right places, but it reads like a generic dinner party and skips the leeches, the hammock and the red seashell crown.
missing: Leeches in the lagoon (Alan picks them off)
Jack Trainer's headshot and mid-credits meditation class
Crown of Fire turning out to be red seashells (tomb ending)
Loretta's sequined jumpsuit running through the jungle
ideas: Swap the 'Chilli lime jungle fruit cups' note for a nod to the leeches, such as 'Lagoon fruit cups, leech free'.
Swap 'Table 22 / Seated near: Dash on every cover' for 'Table 22, next to the hammock'.
Rename 'Crown of fire mango sorbet' note to point at the red seashell crown, so the dessert pays off the film's ending.
Add 'Jack Trainer's calm-down cooler' as the drink name, tied to his meditation class.
iconic: Sequined jumpsuit in the jungle (note, wink)
Dash and Alan on every cover (house line, tagline)
Jack Trainer and the mid-credits meditation (house drink)
Crown of Fire is red seashells (sorbet note)
changed: Fruit cup note nods to the leech check
Sorbet note pays off the red seashell crown
Place card now seats you by the jungle hammock
